rules.name: Dynamic code execution
rules.desc: eval / new Function / vm.runIn* with runtime-composed code is a classic obfuscation and privilege-escalation vector.

rules.name: Base64 / hex blob obfuscation
rules.desc: Long base64 or hex strings usually carry encoded payloads or hidden configuration.

rules.name: Credential / secret access
rules.desc: Reads DSH credential files, the anonymous user id, or model API keys. Even reading secrets outside the plugin's own config is a red flag.

rules.name: Out-of-bounds write
rules.desc: Writes outside the plugin / profile directory via .. traversal or absolute system paths.

rules.name: Binary payload
rules.desc: Executable / native binaries shipped inside the plugin package.

rules.name: Known malicious file hash
rules.desc: A packaged file's SHA-256 matches the local malicious-hashes library.

rules.name: Install / preinstall / postinstall script
rules.desc: Runs arbitrary code at install time, before review can gate it. Requires explicit confirmation.

rules.name: Network egress
rules.desc: HTTP(S)/WebSocket/socket calls. Lines that only target localhost are downgraded to INFO.

rules.name: Child process execution
rules.desc: Spawns processes. Not automatically malicious, but it can escape the plugin sandbox.

rules.name: Session / profile data access
rules.desc: Reads session logs or profile data. Confirm before allowing, since it exposes conversation history.

rules.name: Filesystem write
rules.desc: Generic write operations. Confirm target scope before allowing.

rules.name: Environment variable access
rules.desc: Generic process.env reads; recorded but not restricted.

rules.name: Filesystem read
rules.desc: Read-only file access; recorded for the audit trail.

rules.name: Minified / very long line
rules.desc: Single lines over 3000 chars hinder review; recorded for manual attention.
